recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future THO release drops these Organization Type concepts, handle that as terminology/THO follow-up rather than editing current core source.
issue_request: FHIR-8381 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request from DSTU1 asking that OrganizationType better match Organization's broad scope by adding commercial, community, and other organization type example codes.
initial_application: Commit fa98e23cc599e4454f4d05669e5256ce0bb93644 applied Tracker# 8277, 8381 by adding Clinical Research Sponsor, Community Group, Non-Healthcare Business or Corporation, and Other concepts to source/organization/valueset-organization-type.xml.
additional_context: Later terminology refactoring generated a separate Organization Type code system, and commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 removed UTG/THO-owned code system content from the core checkout. The current active Organization source binds Organization.type to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/organization-type, whose source includes http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/organization-type. The local THO R5 package contains the requested crs, cg, bus, and other concepts.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current core source is correct because it references the active Organization Type value set and the requested example codes are present in the included external terminology code system.

related_jiras.note: The historical applying commit mentions Tracker# 8277 together with FHIR-8381, but no FHIR-8277 snapshot was provided and this seed decision was self-contained.
